snippet.title: Dystopian Parkour Game - Boars in Rome trailer 3
snippet.description:
Free Playtest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3676250?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=video&utm_term=trailer
Itch: https://savagebenji.itch.io/boars-in-rome
Discord: https://discord.gg/CPvzd4SJxC

An updated trailer with some additional game feel effects and an iteration on the player model!

Gameplay inspired by games like Mirrors Edge and Dying Light.
Artstyle inspired by games like Dishonoured and Team Fortress 2.
Music inspired by Death Stranding and Oh Hiroshima.

Sadly, it would be impossible to list all of our favourite inspos here.

Would love to know what you think!
